verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy backwards: the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is set much larger than the quote, which shrinks to small italic. The wordmark is tiny and looks broken ('SOLST CE'), the jar sits off its own circle on the grey one, and the quote mark floats in empty space. B keeps the quote dominant with a small attribution, a readable centred logo, and the jar on its rust circle. But in B the quote mark is stranded far above the line, the vertical gaps are uneven, and the jar is crammed against the right edge.

A is fine on hierarchy (large quote, small gold attribution) and the logo reads clearly. Its flaws are a quote mark floating detached above the line and the jar squeezed into the right corner. B blows the attribution up far above the quote, leaves 'soon.' as an orphan on its own line, and shrinks the logo until it is barely legible. It also puts the jar over the wrong grey circle and leaves the right side empty apart from a bare circle.
